upload.title: Upload a CSV file
upload.failed: The last file could not be checked
upload.help: Columns: sku and quantity (required), price and discount (optional). Comma or semicolon separated, up to 10,000 rows and 5 MB. Repeated SKUs are merged.

codes.INVALID_QUANTITY: Quantity must be a whole number from 1 to 100,000
codes.INVALID_PRICE: Price must be an amount like 12.50
codes.INVALID_DISCOUNT: Discount must be a percent from 0 to 100
codes.QTY_NOT_INCREMENT: Quantity must be in steps of the set increment
codes.DUPLICATE_CONFLICT: Repeated SKU with different prices or discounts

commit.append: Add to the existing lines (same product: quantities are added)

errors.tooLarge: Files can be up to {{maxMb}} MB.

general.title: General
general.prefixHelp: Shown before the number, e.g. Q- → Q-1042. Capital letters, digits and dashes.
general.nextNumberHelp: Can only go up, so numbers are never reused.
general.reserveInventory: Reserve stock while a quote is open
general.reserveInventoryHelp: Draft orders hold the items until the quote expires.
general.notifyEmailsHelp: Comma-separated. Vendora emails these addresses when a quote needs someone.

branding.title: Branding
branding.logoUrlHelp: Upload the logo in Shopify admin → Content → Files, then paste its URL here. PNG or JPG.
branding.termsHelp: Printed at the end of every quote. Up to 4,000 characters.
branding.footerHelp: One line at the bottom of every page, e.g. your company details. Up to 200 characters.

team.title: Team
team.help: Staff appear here after they open Vendora once. Owners manage settings and roles, managers approve quotes, sales reps create and send them, viewers can only look.
team.name: Name

approvals.title: Approval rules
approvals.help: A submitted quote needs a manager's approval when it breaks any of these rules. Quotes in a currency without a limit always need approval.
approvals.maxDiscountHelp: Compared with the catalog price total. Leave empty for no limit.
approvals.differentApprover: The approver must be a different person than the requester
